case.summary: Case CASE-005 (Card SC-03005-K949): Transaction 4012170 ($430.53, domestic) triggered a real-time risk score of 0.85 [EV-43cac9a5]. Card SC-03005-K949 had one prior transaction averaging $253.18 [EV-c1f411ab] and two online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-23176ba1]. The transaction used a new device profile (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with case identifiers) [EV-c475a073] and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-ef87540a]. Customer SC-03005 had one prior confirmed fraud case CC-4320 [EV-da529fde], and the device profile appears in one confirmed fraud case [EV-666ef05f]. Six prior closed cases match the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-b9059328]. The customer denies making the purchases and reports the card still in their possession [EV-e9d40046].

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-005 involving card SC-03005-K949 and transactions 4012170 ($430.53) and 4012171 with total exposure of $683.71. Real-time risk model scored transaction 4012170 at 0.85, triggering review [EV-43cac9a5]. Transaction originated from a previously unseen device profile (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) [EV-c475a073] via an anonymous proxy connection routed through Argentina [EV-ef87540a]. Card transaction history shows only one prior transaction averaging $253.18 [EV-c1f411ab], yet two online transactions occurred within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-23176ba1]. Customer SC-03005 has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4320) [EV-da529fde], and the device profile has been linked to one confirmed fraud case [EV-666ef05f]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior closed cases matching the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-b9059328]. Customer disputes the transactions, stating they did not make the purchases and retain physical possession of the card [EV-e9d40046]. The combination of new device, anonymous proxy, velocity anomaly, prior fraud history, and customer denial supports the fraud verdict.
